blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) clarified on Friday that five former household staff members of Vice President Sara Duterte were not rescued or held captive but were merely accompanied by police personnel at the request of their legal counsel. The PNP issued the clarification after verifying claims made by Duterte’s lawyer, Atty. Paolo Panelo, that the former staff members were allegedly held against their will by their new employers and threatened into signing a document containing false allegations. Panelo also alleged that the former staff members were picked up by their legal counsel, with police assistance, and brought […]...
